verdict.rationale: Community Phone is a home and business phone service whose business tier could plausibly expose programmatic or headless automation, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows management through the mobile app and online dashboard, and probes for OpenAPI specs all returned 404. The 'automated calls' check-in feature is an in-app scheduling feature, not headless or CI operation, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
